title: Mormonism as a UFO religion: Joseph Smith's contacts and downloads

tellings.quote: And if you actually look into Mormonism, it's kind of a UFO religion.

plain: Mormonism is, when you look into it, "kind of a UFO religion": its founder, Joseph Smith, reported contacts with beings and knowledge handed to him in the United States between the 1820s and 1840s. The researcher Matthew Pines makes this point on the show, without naming a source. His point is that a major American religion may have started with the same kind of encounters people now call UFO experiences.
